title: ERP Study Scholarships for Graduates of Economics and Business Administration
summary: ERP Study Scholarships provide foreign graduates of Economics and Business Administration with opportunities to complete a Master's degree course at a state or state-recognised German higher education institution.

degree_levels.notes: A complete Master's degree programme in Germany. Applicants must hold a first degree (Bachelor, Diplom or comparable academic degree).

institutions.notes: State (public) or state-recognised German higher education institution.

nationality.notes: Restricted to specific countries listed in the source page country selection.

residence.notes: Your application cannot be considered, if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

mandatory.text: Hold at least a first academic degree (Bachelor, Diplom or comparable) in Economics and Business Administration at the latest by the time scholarship-supported study commences.
Final examinations of the last academic degree should be taken no longer than six years before the time of application, as a rule.
Apply to three host universities for admission to studies simultaneously.
Not have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.
Provide proof of proficiency in the language of instruction (German, English, or German and English).

funding.description: Scholarship payments of 992 euros a month; Study allowance of 460 euros a year; Payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover; Travel allowance (upon application only); DAAD may fund a German language course for two months before studies begin; Further payments upon application (Family allowances cannot be paid).
funding.duration: 18 - 24 months (scholarships are awarded for degree courses with a duration of 3 or 4 semesters)

application_rounds.notes: Applications can be submitted between 1 June and the stated application deadline. Current dates are updated at least once a year. Source specifies Central European seasonal time. Unnormalised source clock time: 24:00.

recurring_deadline_notes: Applications for this scholarship programme can be submitted annually between 1 June and the stated application deadline.

required_documents.text: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages)
Statement about academic and personal reasons for the planned study project in Germany (letter of motivation; 1 - 2 pages)
Letter of admission to the study programme at the host university in Germany (must be submitted before the funding period begins if not available at application)
Form 'Information about your preferred master programmes'
University degree certificate indicating final grade(s)
Proof of knowledge of language(s) of instruction in the chosen study programme
One recent, supporting letter of recommendation from a university teacher

steps.text: Request recommendation form in the DAAD Portal, have it completed by a university teacher, and upload it.
Complete the online application in full via the DAAD portal.
Upload all required application documents in PDF format to the DAAD portal.

sources.title: ERP Study Scholarships for Graduates of Economics and Business Administration - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Provides funding for international students to complete a Master's degree programme physically in Germany.
